<function name="Toggle" parent="timer" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Runs either <page>timer.Pause</page> or <page>timer.UnPause</page> based on the timer's current status.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="identifier" type="any">Identifier of the timer.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
